one_line: A wealthy 7th-century Vallabhi merchant-philanthropist who endows land and revenue to support the city’s monasteries and learning.

appearance.age_look: early 40s, medium height, solid but not bulky build, with the composed presence of an experienced trader and donor
appearance.face: oval face with medium-brown western Indian complexion, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, straight nose, thoughtful almond-shaped eyes, a few faint worry lines on the forehead, default expression calm and benevolent with a slight businesslike focus
appearance.hair: black hair oiled and combed back, gathered into a short low knot at the back of the head, front hairline clean, topped with a simple off-white turban-cloth wrapped once around the head with a small knot tucked over the left ear
appearance.costume: He wears a long-sleeved knee-length cotton tunic (angarkha-style wrap) in soft cream white with a diagonal opening tied at the right side, over a pair of narrow, ankle-length dhoti-style lower garments in muted warm beige, the fabric finely woven but unpatterned; around his shoulders is a light turmeric-yellow cotton shawl draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back, its edge carrying a thin maroon border; his feet are in simple brown leather sandals; he has a plain gold neck chain, a single small gold ring on the right hand, and a slender bronze bangle on his left wrist, all modest but indicating prosperity.
appearance.signature: A rolled copper-plate land grant tied with a red cord in his right hand, with a simple bronze seal hanging from the cord, and a cloth merchant’s account pouch at his waist, but the copper-plate grant is his main prop, always clearly visible.

ref_desc: A medium-built early-40s Vallabhi merchant with an oval medium-brown face, black knotted hair under an off-white turban, cream tunic, beige dhoti, turmeric-yellow shawl, brown sandals, modest gold jewelry, and a rolled copper-plate land grant with red cord and bronze seal.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model of a 7th-century Vallabhi merchant patron: medium-built man in his early 40s with an oval medium-brown face, short black hair in a low knot under an off-white turban wrap, neatly trimmed beard and calm, thoughtful eyes. He wears a cream white knee-length wrap tunic with long sleeves, a warm beige dhoti-style lower garment to the ankles, and a light turmeric-yellow shawl with a thin maroon border draped from his left shoulder across his chest and around his back. His feet are in simple brown leather sandals. Show a plain gold neck chain, a single small gold ring on his right hand, and a slender bronze bangle on his left wrist. In his right hand he clearly holds a rolled copper-plate land grant tied with a red cord and a hanging bronze seal, with a small cloth account pouch at his waist; keep the copper-plate grant prominent. Use cream white, turmeric yellow, warm beige, maroon, and brown leather as the main colors, and present him in a neutral standing pose suitable for a consistent character reference sheet.
